title: 教师条件预测与证据
research_question: 个人参考规律中的N/E条件信息是否在人员外样本上改善预测，而不是仅产生非零失配？
current_evidence: Single source-fold comparison of three architectures and three learning rates completed for three excluded-person components; full-fold SENS pending.

tasks.description: 比较既有共享教师、纯H和可关闭N/E条件残差；源内层预测损失选型
复核H/HN/HNE和单源目标的校准、条件增益、参考长度与教师集成
交付带排除审计和hash的固定证据包，保持旧教师与旧缓存可追溯

acceptance: 每个被评分人员被排除于对应共享教师拟合和选择
同时报告条件增益、NLL、覆盖/PIT与失败；不用目标预警成绩选教师
resources: CPU for preparation and bounded checks; full refits require measured capacity, dedicated GPU recommended where appropriate; no mandatory API
delivery_status: Source-only teacher development study completed; formal full-fold SENS remains pending.
